notes: Peer Comps was the last thing that kept a "peer set" outside the cohort system. A security's peers are not a different kind of object from the S&P 500 or a sector — they are a named set of securities whose membership follows a rule. The only difference is that the rule has a *subject*: these are AAPL's peers. So peer groups are now cohorts, of a new kind — peer. The first time you open a name's Peer Comps, its peer group is auto-created as a peer.<SYMBOL> cohort and appears in the Cohorts catalog under Peer groups.
